links.outcome: Hallucination and factual grounding under global versus local GraphRAG retrieval modes
links.effect: Local retrieval outperformed global summarization in latency and factual grounding with reduced hallucination; best answer quality was 3.3/5 (Qwen 2.5); Mistral showed degenerate repetition.
links.quote: In addition, indexing and answer quality are decoupled across models, and local retrieval consistently outperforms global summarization in both latency and factual grounding, with reduced hallucination.

screen.reason: Evaluates local/on-premise deployment of open-source LLMs using GraphRAG (local vs global retrieval modes) for privacy-sensitive healthcare EHR schema retrieval on consumer hardware.
